note_en: 居然 expresses the speaker's surprise that something completely unexpected happened, like "of all things" or "would you believe." In the text: 他们在楼下的超市里排过队，在小花园里遛过狗，居然谁也没认出谁 "they had stood in line at the supermarket downstairs, walked dogs in the little garden — and amazingly, neither recognized the other." 居然 goes before the predicate; the similar 竟然 sounds a bit more formal.
